label: Composition from a proper component in…: An individual is composite in the finite model if a…
term: composition from a proper component in a finite model
definition: An individual is composite in the finite model if a numerically different bearer is marked as its proper component. This supplies one explicit instance of composition; it does not claim to exhaust Thomistic kinds of composition.
note: The countermodel provides a determinate witness to non-simplicity without defining simplicity or necessity. Connect this limited part structure to the existing DEF-SIMPLE before drawing a metaphysical conclusion.
